problem_statement: ZMS public API functions (zms_mount, zms_clear, zms_write, zms_read, zms_read_hist, zms_get_data_length, zms_delete, zms_calc_free_space, zms_active_sector_free_space, zms_sector_use_next) crash when called with a NULL file system pointer. They should return -EINVAL instead of dereferencing the NULL pointer. Additionally, zms_active_sector_free_space returns an unsigned type (size_t), which cannot represent negative error codes like -EACCES or -EINVAL; it should return a signed type (ssize_t) to support error return values.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p qemu_x86 -T tests/subsys/fs/zms -s tests/subsys/fs/zms/filesystem.zms -s filesystem.zms -O twister-out --no-clean -W
